reason: A DSH Web interface enhancement focused on conversation layout, workspace file navigation, Git status display, session indicators, and conversation font controls.

summaries.zh: 用于优化 DSH Web 对话布局并提供带 Git 状态的工作区文件树、会话状态显示和字号调节功能。
summaries.en: Enhances the DSH Web interface with a cleaner conversation layout, a workspace file tree with Git status, session indicators, and adjustable conversation text size.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH Web conversation layout and hides tool-call cards
Adds a workspace file tree with lazy loading and Git status indicators
Reads workspace filesystem contents and Git metadata through host-side routes
Opens selected files using the Windows system shell
Reads host credentials data to display model balance or usage information
